q: The topological entropy of a continuous map T: X → X (X compact metric) via spanning sets is: h_top(T) = lim_{ε→0} lim sup_{n→∞} (1/n) log s(n,ε), where s(n,ε) is:
opts: The number of periodic orbits of period n
The minimum number of balls of radius ε needed to cover X
exp: Both definitions (spanning and separating sets) give the same entropy. s(n,ε) = maximum number of (n,ε)-separated points (no two within ε in the first n iterates). Equivalently use r(n,ε) = min spanning set; both give h_top via the same limit.
